study type: case-control study with an intervention comparison subgroup
outcome: severity of autism (ASD score, ASD score growth rate, ASD score change rate, complications, cure rate)
cohort: The study included 120 autistic children (divided into two psychological intervention subgroups) and 120 non-autistic control children.
finding: 5-HT, Hcy, feeding mode, vitamin B12 level, and febrile convulsion were identified as main risk factors for autism in children, with 5-HT and Hcy levels also showing predictive effects on autism development, while psychological intervention served as a protective factor.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a factor with significant differences between autistic and control groups.
cross-section timing: Measurements of 5-HT and Hcy levels were performed at the time of the study.
